ai.title: Cloud planner routes on DeepSeek V4 Flash instead of MiniMax M3
ai.summary: The Freebuff Cloud custom-stack planner now pins `CLOUD_PLANNER_MODEL_ID` to `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_MODEL_ID` in `common/src/constants/free-agents.ts`, replacing the previous `FREEBUFF_MINIMAX_M3_MODEL_ID` used for full access (limited tiers already ran `CLOUD_PLANNER_LIMITED_MODEL_ID`). ai.title: CLI 1.0.686: AVX2 crash persistence, watchdog opt-out, Windows theme
ai.summary: The release launcher now records a machine as lacking AVX2 after an illegal-instruction failure via `recordMachineLacksAvx2()`, which writes `cpu-features.json` so `readCachedAvx2()` answers upfront on the next launch instead of relying on a prior PowerShell CPUID probe. To make the optimistic-then-corrected AVX2 path testable, the launcher's exported `__testing` object exposes `detectMachineHasAvx2`, `recordMachineLacksAvx2`, `readCachedAvx2`, and the other internals, and the `configDirOverride` option lets tests redirect config out of the real `~/.config/manicode`. The terminal-reset watchdog gained a `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` env opt-out for locked-down Windows machines where the PowerShell bootstrap trips EDR/AV, and `detectPlatformTheme` in `theme-system.ts` drops its Windows PowerShell probes so the platform falls through to `dark` rather than reporting an unrelated child host's background color.
ai.evidence: diff hunk in cli/release-core/launcher.js adds `configDirOverride` to the destructured config with a test-only comment, and the final return object includes a `__testing` block listing `detectMachineHasAvx2`, `recordMachineLacksAvx2`, `readCachedAvx2`, `isIllegalInstructionExit`, `getDefaultTargetKey`, `getCpuFeatureCachePath`, `getCurrentVersion`, `isTargetAllowedForThisMachine`, and `CONFIG`; the same file adds `recordMachineLacksAvx2()` which writes `cpu-features.json`, and comments state `tryFallbackToBaseline` calls `recordMachineLacksAvx2()` after a recorded illegal-instruction failure; cli/src/types/env.ts and cli/src/utils/env.ts add `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG`; cli/src/utils/terminal-watchdog.ts adds `isOptedOut` and checks `CODEBUFF_NO_TERMINAL_WATCHDOG` to skip arming in `startTerminalWatchdog`; cli/src/utils/theme-system.ts removes the `detectWindowsPowerShellTheme` helper and the win32 `HKCU AppsUseLightTheme` read from `detectPlatformTheme`, leaving Windows to fall through to `'dark'`.
ai.migration: If you previously relied on the CLI probing PowerShell for Windows CPU features or theme colors, those probes are removed and no action is required.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the consumer of the new `configDirOverride` option or which package passes it into `createLauncher()`.
